name: Eclipse
source:
"It's nice to meet you, Kuroto."
The unaccented voice came from somewhere...
"Welcome to the world of Eclipse."

Eclipse is an immersive online game that links to all five body senses through special gear. Kuroto, the protagonist, has been chosen as an alpha tester to attempt to finish the game in 4 days. As he logs in to meet his NPC partner, he thinks, "I hope she's cute..."

[from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE072131.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
「很高兴认识你，黑斗。」
一个毫无抑扬的声音从某处传来……
「欢迎来到Eclipse的世界。」

Eclipse是一款通过特殊装备连接人体五感的沉浸式在线游戏。主人公黑斗获选为α测试者，尝试在四天内完成游戏。登录后，他想到即将见面的NPC搭档，不禁心想：「希望她很可爱……」

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE072131.html]DLsite English[/url]]
